reaction: The inward and outward arrows bring the separate pathways together clearly.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the completed pathways to the brain and spinal cord was most worthwhile because it brought touch, stretch and movement into one relationship.

leastWorthwhile.text: Assembling the touch pathway was clear but predictable; its result added little beyond what the item names already suggested.

surprise.text: The explanation that muscle spindles contribute to our sense of limb position gave the stretch pathway a purpose beyond simply detecting stretch.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The named slots made the pathway fittings clear, though they also made those choices predictable.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: connecting the arm to the rest of the body could develop the relationship between cellular work and body systems further.
